name: Tunnel gen4
summary: Tunnel Gen4 is a breakout-based Expert Advisor that identifies price tunnel/channel consolidation zones and enters trades when price breaks out of the defined range. It uses configurable tunnel boundaries to detect periods of low volatility followed by directional expansion, managing positions with stop loss and take profit targets.
summary_zh: Tunnel Gen4是一个基于突破策略的智能交易系统，通过识别价格隧道/通道整理区间，在价格突破定义范围时入场交易。它使用可配置的隧道边界来检测低波动率后的方向性扩张，并通过止损和止盈目标管理仓位。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于价格隧道突破，即在市场进入窄幅整理（隧道）后，等待价格突破隧道边界时入场交易。入场条件为价格向上突破隧道上轨时开多单，向下突破隧道下轨时开空单，突破确认可通过K线收盘价或突破幅度阈值来验证。出场条件包括固定止盈和止损水平，也可能包含隧道反向突破平仓机制。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例手数计算方式。资金管理方面提供了最大持仓限制和单笔风险控制参数，但整体依赖突破后的趋势延续假设，在假突破场景下可能产生连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on price tunnel breakout, entering trades when price breaks out of a narrow consolidation range (tunnel). Entry conditions trigger a buy when price breaks above the upper tunnel boundary and a sell when it breaks below the lower boundary, with optional confirmation via candle close or breakout magnitude threshold. Exit conditions include fixed take profit and stop loss levels, and potentially a reverse breakout closure mechanism that exits when price re-enters or breaks the opposite tunnel boundary. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or balance-proportional calculation methods. Money management incorporates maximum position limits and per-trade risk control parameters, though the overall approach relies on the assumption of trend continuation after breakout, which can produce consecutive losses in false breakout scenarios.

parameters.name: TunnelPeriod
parameters.description: 隧道计算周期，用于确定价格通道的上下轨
parameters.description_en: Tunnel calculation period for upper/lower bands

parameters.name: BreakoutThreshold
parameters.description: 突破确认的最小点数阈值
parameters.description_en: Minimum breakout confirmation threshold in pips

parameters.name: MaxPositions
parameters.description: 允许同时持有的最大仓位数

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description_en: Magic number identifier for EA orders

pros: 隧道突破策略逻辑清晰，在趋势启动初期入场可获取较大利润空间
可配置的突破阈值有助于过滤假突破信号，减少无效交易
参数化设计较好，用户可根据不同品种和市场环境调整隧道参数和风控设置
pros_en: Tunnel breakout strategy has clear logic, entering at trend inception can capture large profit potential
Configurable breakout threshold helps filter false breakout signals and reduce ineffective trades
Well-parameterized design allows users to adjust tunnel parameters and risk settings for different instruments and market conditions
cons: 在震荡市中假突破频繁发生，可能导致连续止损
缺少市场状态过滤器，无法自动区分趋势行情和震荡行情
突破策略对滑点和点差敏感，在高点差品种上表现可能不佳
cons_en: Frequent false breakouts in ranging markets can lead to consecutive stop losses
Lacks market regime filter to automatically distinguish trending from ranging conditions
Breakout strategy is sensitive to slippage and spread, may underperform on high-spread instruments
improvements: 增加ATR或波动率过滤器，在低波动环境下缩小隧道或暂停交易以避免假突破
加入多时间框架确认机制，例如要求高周期趋势方向与突破方向一致
实现动态止损止盈，根据ATR或隧道宽度自适应调整盈亏比
improvements_en: Add ATR or volatility filter to narrow the tunnel or pause trading in low-volatility environments to avoid false breakouts
Implement multi-timeframe confirmation, requiring higher-timeframe trend direction to align with breakout direction
Implement dynamic stop loss and take profit that adapt based on ATR or tunnel width for optimal risk-reward ratios

risk_points: 假突破在震荡市中频繁发生可能导致连续亏损
缺少市场状态识别机制，在非趋势行情中仍会开仓
突破入场对执行滑点敏感，大波动时实际成交价可能偏离预期
risk_points_en: False breakouts in ranging markets can cause consecutive losses
No market regime identification, continues opening positions in non-trending conditions
Breakout entries are sensitive to execution slippage, actual fill prices may deviate from expected during high volatility

It uses configurable tunnel boundaries to detect periods of low volatility followed by directional expansion, managing positions with stop loss and take profit targets.
